summary: Receptor on automation mesh nodes can send outbound traffic through a proxy that doesn't strip TLS; each node gets an installer-created CA at /etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.crt and a cert and key at /etc/receptor/tls/NODEID.crt and NODEID.key.
questions: Can automation mesh traffic go through a proxy?
Where is the receptor mesh CA certificate?
Where are the receptor node certificates stored?
